summary: Test-only change under e2e/: new helper e2e/support/keyboard.ts (buttonTabKey probes a static, hard-coded HTML snippet on a throwaway page in the same browser context, closed in finally), new e2e/keyboard-helper.spec.ts, and four specs switched from a browserName check to the helper. No untrusted input reaches any sink: setContent takes only literal strings, evaluate reads document.activeElement.tagName only, and no shell, file, network or storage operations are added. The probe page is about:blank content so it issues no requests and doesn't affect the per-page request listeners used by the same-origin checks. No production code, secrets, randomness or dependencies change (changes.md: no new dependencies). The helper fails closed by throwing when neither key reaches a button. No findings.
